title: There's always a bigger fish
subtitle: Lamborghini
description_it:
The Lamborghini Huracán STO (Super Trofeo Omologata) is a track-focused, road-legal supercar that serves as the ultimate evolution of the Huracán lineage, directly inheriting technology from the Huracán Super Trofeo EVO and GT3 EVO race cars.
Key Specifications and Features:
Engine and Performance: It is powered by a naturally aspirated 5.2-liter V10 engine producing 640 CV (470 kW) and 565 Nm of torque…
